resources.string: ✖ Notification ki ijazat nahi — is ke baghair app calls nahi pakad sakti
Fehrist mein TaxNest Caller ID dhoond kar on karein
Pehle notification ki ijazat dein — neeche button dabayein

Yeh app shop ke phone par aane wali calls (aam call aur WhatsApp call) ki notification parhti hai aur number POS ko bhej deti hai — sale screen par foran popup aata hai ke kaun sa gaahak call kar raha hai aur us ki purani khareedari kya hai. App ko khula rakhne ki zaroorat nahi, bas phone on rahe.
Ijazat dene se pehle yeh parh lein. TaxNest Caller ID aap ke phone ki notifications is tarah istemal karti hai:

1) App sirf aane wali call wali notification parhti hai, aur woh bhi sirf do jagahon se: aap ke phone ki apni call wali app (dialer) se, aur WhatsApp / WhatsApp Business se. Us mein se sirf call karne wale ka number aur naam liya jata hai.

2) Baqi har notification nazar-andaz kar di jati hai — paighamat, chat, email, aur doosri apps ki calls bhi (Messenger, Telegram, Viber, Skype waghaira) — na parhi jati hai, na mehfooz hoti hai, na kahin bheji jati hai.

3) Sirf chaar cheezein aap hi ke TaxNest shop account ko (taxnest.pk par, mehfooz HTTPS connection se) bheji jati hain: number, naam, waqt, aur call SIM ki thi ya WhatsApp ki. Kisi teesre fareeq ko kuch nahi diya jata.
4) Maqsad sirf ek hai: aap ki POS sale screen par foran popup aa jaye ke kaun sa gaahak call kar raha hai aur us ki pichli khareedari kya hai.

5) Call ka yeh record taqreeban 48 ghante baad khud mit jata hai. Ijazat aap jab chahen phone ki settings se wapas le sakte hain, ya POS → Customize se feature band / phone revoke kar sakte hain — app phir bhi chalti rahegi.
